basic_info.description:
Available for rent is an updated bright single-family Sunset house:

3 bedrooms, 2 bathroom, kitchen, living room, dining room.
On the main level there are 2 bedrooms with ocean views and 1 bathroom.
On the lower level there is a master suite with a wet bar overlooking landscaped backyard.
Hardwood floors and double-pane windows throughout.
1 car garage with additional 2 spaces on the driveway.
Washer, dryer and lots of additional storage space in the garage.
Garage has fast Electric Car charger (220V, 40A) and bike racks.
Extra large backyard perfect for personal enjoyment and entertaining guests.
Only 4 blocks to the beautiful Sunset Beach. Hiking and biking paths.
3.5 blocks to Golden Gate Park. Steps away from multiple public transport, shops and restaurants.

Can be optionally rented furnished.

Tenant pays all utilities: PG&E, Water, Garbage
